pr_title: Remove workaround channel listener in ESQL

issue_context.title: ESQL: Remove OwningChannelActionListener
issue_context.body:
[This PR](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/102638) introduced `OwningChannelActionListener`, a thin wrapper around `ChannelActionListener` that `decRef`s (i.e. closes) responses when calling `onResponse`.

`OwningChannelActionListener` is deprecated because it is not consistent with other `ActionListeners` - which are normally ref count neutral.

Remove `OwningChannelActionListener`. Probably replace by `ChannelActionListener` and make sure that we close all responses after using them in `ChannelActionListener.onResponse`.

review_comments:
Does this mean we never decRef/release `DriverRequest`s anymore?

If so, this is probably okay because `DriverRequest`s don't hold resources that need to be released - but it's slightly less correct than before.
Simillarly here, this is probably fine but technically now `DataNodeResponse`s never get released, I think.
